wavelink.isConnected.description: Checks whether Cuebot is connected to Elgato Wave Link right now.

wavelink.connect.description: Looks for Wave Link and starts connecting. It does not wait: Cuebot keeps trying in the background. Wave Link only runs on Windows and macOS.
wavelink.connect.returns: true when Wave Link can run on this computer (connecting has started), false when it cannot (for example on Linux).

wavelink.getStatus.description: Tells you about the Wave Link connection and what Cuebot found in it.
wavelink.getStatus.returns: isConnected, isAvailable, status (a status line), api ("3" for Wave Link 3, "legacy" for 1.x/2.x), port, interfaceRevision and how many channels, mixes, inputDevices and outputDevices there are.

wavelink.getChannels.description: Lists your Wave Link channels (in Wave Link 1.x/2.x: inputs) and how they are set.
wavelink.getChannels.returns: A list of channels. Each has id, name, type, muted, volume, mixes (mute, volume and filterBypassed per mix), effects (name, enabled) and apps.

wavelink.getMixes.description: Lists your Wave Link mixes, like Stream Mix and Monitor Mix.
wavelink.getMixes.returns: A list of mixes. Each has id, name, muted and volume.

wavelink.getInputDevices.description: Lists your Wave Link input devices (in Wave Link 1.x/2.x: microphones) and their settings.
wavelink.getInputDevices.returns: A list of devices. Each has id, name, type and inputs (muted, gain, gainDb, gainLocked, micPcMix, lowCut, clipGuard).

wavelink.getOutputDevices.description: Lists your Wave Link output devices, like headphones and speakers.
wavelink.getOutputDevices.returns: main (the main output's name), monitoredMix (the mix you hear) and devices (each with id, name and outputs: muted, volume, mixId).

wavelink.setChannelMute.description: Mutes or unmutes a Wave Link channel. Fails with an error when Wave Link is not connected.

parameters.channel: The channel, by name or id, like "Music" or "Game".
parameters.mix: Optional. Only in this mix, like "Stream Mix". Leave it empty for the whole channel (Wave Link 1.x/2.x: both mixes).

wavelink.setChannelMute.returns: The new state: true when muted, false when not.

wavelink.setChannelVolume.description: Changes the volume of a Wave Link channel. Fails with an error when Wave Link is not connected.

parameters.channel: The channel, by name or id, like "Music" or "Game".
parameters.mix: Optional. Only in this mix, like "Stream Mix". Leave it empty for the channel itself.
parameters.relative: Optional. true adds the number to the current value instead (use a minus number to go down). Default false.

wavelink.setChannelEffect.description: Turns an effect on a Wave Link channel on or off (in Wave Link 1.x/2.x: an input filter). Fails with an error when Wave Link is not connected.

parameters.channel: The channel, by name or id, like "Music" or "Game".
parameters.effect: The effect or filter, by name or id, like "Noise Gate".

wavelink.setChannelEffect.returns: The new state: true for on, false for off.

wavelink.setFilterBypass.description: Skips (bypasses) all filters on a Wave Link input, or turns them back on. Only for Wave Link 1.x/2.x. Fails with an error when Wave Link is not connected.

parameters.channel: The channel, by name or id, like "Music" or "Game".
parameters.mix: Optional. Only in this mix, like "Stream Mix". Leave it empty for both mixes.

wavelink.setFilterBypass.returns: The new state: true when the filters are skipped, false when they work.

wavelink.addAppToChannel.description: Sends an app's sound to a Wave Link channel, like putting Spotify on the Music channel. Only for Wave Link 3. Fails with an error when Wave Link is not connected.

parameters.channel: The channel, by name or id, like "Music" or "Game".
parameters.app: Optional. The app, by name or id, like "Spotify". Leave it empty for the app that is in front right now.

wavelink.addAppToChannel.returns: The name of the app that was moved.

wavelink.setMixMute.description: Mutes or unmutes a whole Wave Link mix. Fails with an error when Wave Link is not connected.

parameters.mix: The mix, by name or id, like "Stream Mix" or "Monitor Mix".

wavelink.setMixMute.returns: The new state: true when muted, false when not.

wavelink.setMixVolume.description: Changes the volume of a whole Wave Link mix. Fails with an error when Wave Link is not connected.

parameters.mix: The mix, by name or id, like "Stream Mix" or "Monitor Mix".
parameters.relative: Optional. true adds the number to the current value instead (use a minus number to go down). Default false.

wavelink.setInputMute.description: Mutes or unmutes a Wave Link input device, like your microphone. Fails with an error when Wave Link is not connected.

parameters.device: The input device or microphone, by name or id, like "Wave:3".

wavelink.setInputMute.returns: The new state: true when muted, false when not.

wavelink.setInputGain.description: Changes the gain (how loud the mic picks you up) of a Wave Link input. Fails with an error when Wave Link is not connected.

parameters.device: The input device or microphone, by name or id, like "Wave:3".
parameters.gain: The gain. Wave Link 3: 0-100 percent. Wave Link 1.x/2.x: the microphone's own gain number.
parameters.relative: Optional. true adds the number to the current value instead (use a minus number to go down). Default false.

wavelink.setMicPcBalance.description: Changes the Mic/PC balance of a Wave Link input: how much of your mic versus your computer sound you hear. Fails with an error when Wave Link is not connected.

parameters.device: The input device or microphone, by name or id, like "Wave:3".
parameters.relative: Optional. true adds the number to the current value instead (use a minus number to go down). Default false.

wavelink.setInputLowCut.description: Turns the low cut filter (it removes deep rumble) of a Wave Link input on or off. Fails with an error when Wave Link is not connected.

parameters.device: The input device or microphone, by name or id, like "Wave:3".

wavelink.setInputLowCut.returns: The new state: true for on, false for off.

wavelink.setInputClipGuard.description: Turns Clipguard (it stops your mic from distorting when you get loud) of a Wave Link input on or off. Fails with an error when Wave Link is not connected.

parameters.device: The input device or microphone, by name or id, like "Wave:3".

wavelink.setInputClipGuard.returns: The new state: true for on, false for off.

wavelink.setMainOutput.description: Picks the main output device in Wave Link: where you listen. Fails with an error when Wave Link is not connected.

parameters.device: The output device, by name or id, like "Headphones".

wavelink.setMainOutput.returns: The name of the new main output.

wavelink.setOutputVolume.description: Changes the volume of a Wave Link output device. Only for Wave Link 3. Fails with an error when Wave Link is not connected.

parameters.device: The output device, by name or id, like "Headphones".
parameters.relative: Optional. true adds the number to the current value instead (use a minus number to go down). Default false.

wavelink.setMonitoredMix.description: Picks which Wave Link mix you hear on your main output. Fails with an error when Wave Link is not connected.

parameters.mix: The mix, by name or id, like "Stream Mix" or "Monitor Mix".

wavelink.setMonitoredMix.returns: The name of the mix you hear now.

wavelink.addOutputToMix.description: Plays a Wave Link mix on an output device. Only for Wave Link 3. Fails with an error when Wave Link is not connected.

parameters.device: The output device, by name or id, like "Headphones".
parameters.mix: The mix, by name or id, like "Stream Mix" or "Monitor Mix".

wavelink.switchMonitoring.description: Switches what you hear between Monitor Mix and Stream Mix. Only for Wave Link 1.x/2.x; Wave Link 3 fails with an error (use wavelink.setMonitoredMix). Fails with an error when Wave Link is not connected.
wavelink.switchMonitoring.returns: The name of the mix you hear now.
